identity.title: List of Japanese language XY home video releases

source.sourceCategory: Category:Lists of animation home video releases

leadText: The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of Pocket Monsters XY of the Pokémon animated series. All the DVDs were released for rental only.
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of Pocket Monsters XY of the Pokémon animated series. All the DVDs were released for rental only.

==Volume releases==
Pocket Monsters XY was divided into two sets that were released by Shogakukan from 2014 to 2017. It contains all the 146 episodes between them.

===Pocket Monsters XY===
Pocket Monsters XY was released by Shogakukan from 2014 to 2016. It consists of 32 volumes with 96 episodes across them combined.

Special Episode: The Strongest Mega Evolution ~Act IV~ was released in the following set.

 

===Pocket Monsters XY&Z===
Pocket Monsters XY&Z was released by Shogakukan from 2016 to 2017. It consists of 16 volumes with 50 episodes across them combined.

Special Episode: The Strongest Mega Evolution ~Act IV~ was included in the first volume.
